rows.rationale: PO, goods receipt and invoice all agree at 200 EACH @ $4.20 with no price variance (clause 3) and no quantity variance (clause 4); the 3-way match for this GOODS PO is complete (clause 1). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% is exactly $63.00, matching the supplier figure (clause 5), and there are no credit memos or non-PO lines. Net payable $903.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

The only exception was unit-of-measure: the supplier billed 480 EACH @ $2.00 against a PO of 40 CASE @ $24.00, and at the pack size of 12 in vendor.json these are identical ($960.00 net). Clause 2 makes that a routine normalisation, not a defect. Receipt GR-7702 confirms 40 CASE received (clause 1 three-way match satisfied), price variance is $0.00 (clause 3), and recomputed tax at 7.5% is exactly $72.00 (clause 5). No credit memos; net payable $1,032.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

The $1.10/unit price increase (62.00 -> 63.10) is 1.77%, inside the clause 3 band (lower of 2% = $1.24 and $50.00), so it is not a defect. Goods receipt GR-7703 confirms 100 EACH received against 100 ordered and 100 invoiced (clause 1 3-way match, clause 4). Recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% is exactly $473.25 (clause 5). No credit memos; payable $6,783.25 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clauses 9-10).

defects: Price variance outside tolerance and uncured: invoiced $154.00/EACH vs PO $145.00/EACH (+6.21%, $9.00 vs allowance $2.90)
rows.rationale: The invoiced unit price of $154.00/EACH exceeds the PO price of $145.00/EACH by 6.21% ($9.00), outside the clause 3 band (lower of 2% = $2.90 and $50.00). The only supporting evidence is a unilateral supplier price notice from Kestrel's billing department; it is not from or countersigned by a listed authorised buyer (Dele Fashanu, Priya Raman), so it does not cure the variance under clause 3.1. Quantities match the receipt (80 EACH) and tax is exact, so this is a single defect — hold for buyer action per clause 12, payable $0.00.

The invoiced unit price of $93.28 is exactly 6% over the PO's $88.00, outside the clause 3 band (lower of 2% / $50.00 = $1.76), but the variance is cured under clause 3.1: authorised buyer Dele Fashanu approved in writing 'up to 6% on PO-4405, conduit line only'. Receipt GR-7705 confirms 60 EACH against 60 ordered and invoiced (clause 4, no variance), and recomputed tax at 7.5% matches the supplier's $419.76 exactly (clause 5). No defects, no credit memos; $6,016.56 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Quantity shortfall: 100 EACH invoiced, only 60 EACH received (40 on backorder) — clause 4 under-delivery
rows.rationale: Goods receipt GR-7706 shows only 60 of 100 EACH delivered, with 40 on backorder, so under clause 4 the quantity resolves in favour of the receipt and payment is limited to the received quantity: 60 × $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3, no variance). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net gives $42.75 (clause 5) for a corrected gross of $612.75; the supplier's $71.25 is simply the tax on the over-invoiced quantity, not an independent tax defect. Single defect, no credit memos, so clause 11 escalation is not triggered and clause 10 puts approval with AP_CLERK.

The prior invoice INV-3221 matches on vendor, PO and amount within 28 days, but it covers February 2026 while this one covers March 2026 — distinct, non-overlapping service periods make this a legitimate recurring retainer charge, not a duplicate (clause 8.1). PO-4408 is a SERVICES blanket PO, so no goods receipt is expected (clause 1); price matches the PO exactly (clause 3) and tax of $360.00 equals 7.5% of $4,800.00 (clause 5). No credit memos outstanding; $5,160.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clauses 9–10).

Goods line matches PO and receipt exactly (150 EACH @ $18.00) and tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to $231.00 exactly (clauses 3-5). The $380.00 expedited freight line is a permitted pass-through: contract clause 6.2 allows the actual carrier charge for buyer-requested expedited delivery up to $500.00, and GR-7709 records that production requested overnight freight, so it is not a defect under clause 6/11.1. Net payable $3,311.00, no open credit memos, AP_CLERK band per clause 10.

defects: Tax overcharge: supplier billed $744.00 tax (12%) against the vendor's 7.5% rate, $279.00 above the recomputed $465.00 (clause 5)
rows.rationale: Price and quantity match the PO and receipt exactly (clauses 3, 4), but the supplier applied roughly 12% tax where vendor.json fixes the rate at 7.5%. Correct tax on the $6,200.00 net is $465.00, so the corrected gross is $6,665.00 — a $279.00 overcharge, far beyond the $0.02 rounding allowance, requiring SHORT_PAY of the corrected total under clause 5. Single defect, so no clause 11 escalation; $6,665.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

The apparent price gap is purely currency: contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated 1 Jan–31 Mar 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH is exactly USD 231.00/EACH as invoiced — normalisation, not a defect (clause 7, clause 11.1). Goods receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 EACH received against 40 ordered and invoiced (clause 4), and recomputed tax at 7.5% is exactly $693.00 (clause 5). No defects; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Over-delivery beyond 5%: 118 EACH received against a PO quantity of 100 EACH (18% over, clause 4)
rows.rationale: Prices match the PO exactly and the goods receipt confirms 118 EACH, but the receipt exceeds the PO quantity of 100 EACH by 18%, far beyond the 5% over-delivery tolerance in clause 4 — the supplier shipped a full carton instead of the ordered count. That is the single defect (clause 11.1), so no escalation applies; the invoice is held for receiving/buyer action at $0.00 per clause 12.

PO-4413 is a SERVICES PO, so 2-way match applies and the absence of a goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1). Price and quantity match the PO exactly (clause 3), recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% rate equals the invoiced $562.50 (clause 5), and vendor.json lists no prior invoices or open credit memos, so no duplicate or netting issue arises (clauses 8, 9). Net payable $8,062.50 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).

defects: Quantity shortfall: 1050 CASE received against 1200 CASE ordered and invoiced (clause 4 under-delivery)

Two defects and a payable above $25,000.00 both force escalation (clause 11); CONTROLLER approval applies (clause 10).

defects: Quantity shortfall on line 4: 25 gland plates invoiced, only 20 received (clause 4)

rows.rationale: Line 2 reconciles exactly once converted (40 CASE @ 24.60 = 480 EACH @ 2.05, clause 2 — not a defect), and line 3's 45.80 vs 45.00 is within the 2%/$0.90 band (clause 3). No buyer authorisation from a listed authorised buyer exists in the case evidence, so clause 3.1 does not cure it. Quantities match the receipt (2 EACH ordered, received, invoiced) and tax at 7.5% recomputes to $611.25 exactly, so this is the single defect — clause 12 gives HOLD_PRICE_VARIANCE at $0.00 pending buyer action.
